The Chinese characters for Helen

Origin and meaning

The name Helen has Greek roots and means “bright, shining light”.

About the name Helen

Helen of Troy, the most beautiful woman in Greek myth, bore this name.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “bright, shining light”, a Helen calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
